mechanism: Freeze the user task before a complex run, make stage authority explicit, and distinguish installation, launch, execution, cleanup, and delivery evidence instead of treating one receipt as proof of all of them.
productionProposal: Adapt only the proof-boundary and task-fidelity concepts into existing Forge and Mnemosyne contracts. Keep activation selective and proportional; do not import the upstream runtime or its mandatory multi-stop ceremony.
existingOverlap: Godskills already has capability routing, certified activation, evidence packets, and completion gates. The useful discriminator is whether a smaller task-fidelity packet and explicit proof taxonomy reduce overclaiming without adding routine user stops.
rejectOrAdapt: Reject slash-command dependence, universal hard stops, hidden runtime ownership, installer/update behavior, upstream bundle adoption, and benchmark claims as proof of local superiority.
dependenciesAndRisks: The upstream entry delegates to a substantial Python runtime and host decision protocol. Importing that runtime would duplicate existing authority and create competing state machines.
qualification: Shadow-test on complex and simple tasks. Measure verbatim constraint preservation, false completion claims, unnecessary stops, context cost, and whether native Godskills routing remains the sole authority.
license: Apache-2.0 root license with NOTICE; third-party content retains separate licenses.

mechanism: Classify retirement by responsibility and deletion class, require a named canonical owner, and verify the main path, lingering references, negative behavior, and compatibility boundary separately.
productionProposal: Fold the four-part retirement verification and responsibility-scoped owner collapse into Aegis as an optional high-risk closeout facet rather than creating another global skill.
existingOverlap: Eternities Aegis already governs destructive actions and external boundaries. This source adds a crisp distinction between internal code retirement, contract-carrying code, derived state, and irreversible persistent state.
rejectOrAdapt: Do not treat loading a safety skill as deletion authorization. Do not adopt delete-first as a blanket rule when external consumers or persistent state are uncertain.
dependenciesAndRisks: The mechanism is mostly procedural. Its main risk is overconfident classification of an apparently internal carrier whose consumers are not visible.
qualification: Use seeded migration cases containing stale internal owners, a hidden external consumer, rebuildable cache data, and irreversible live state. Require correct path choice and zero unauthorized destructive action.

mechanism: Freeze a small claim map, bind every experiment to a belief-changing question, separate must-run from nice-to-have, and order runs through explicit stop/go gates.
productionProposal: Create a domain-neutral experiment-planning facet for Oracle and Forge. Preserve claim-to-evidence linkage, anti-claims, failure interpretation, resource budgets, and early stop gates without assuming an academic paper.
existingOverlap: Oracle already investigates consequential questions and Forge executes staged plans. The useful addition is a compact experiment portfolio that can cut low-value work before execution.
rejectOrAdapt: Remove fixed paper-section outputs, slash commands, frontier-model assumptions, hard-coded claim counts, and instructions that silently fall back to shell file writes.
dependenciesAndRisks: The source assumes research logs and related ARIS skills. A universal version must work with local tests, simulations, user studies, or operational trials and must never invent compute or data budgets.
qualification: Compare native planning with the facet on one ML study, one UI experiment, and one reliability investigation. Score claim coverage, wasted runs, negative-result handling, budget truthfulness, and execution readiness.

mechanism: Detect source type before extraction, use examples and tests as separate evidence channels, split oversized knowledge into focused capabilities, and package only after validation.
productionProposal: Use the source-type and test-example concepts to strengthen the existing quarry/refinery intake contract. Keep extraction local and evidence-first; vector export remains an optional retrieval implementation, not the skill truth.
existingOverlap: The current refinery already deduplicates, preserves provenance, and keeps sources cold. The possible gain is better source adapters and explicit fixture/example classification.
rejectOrAdapt: Reject automatic installation, upload, scraping, model enhancement, or vector-database export as default behavior. Do not confuse generated documentation with a qualified capability.
dependenciesAndRisks: The upstream workflow assumes a large MCP tool surface and optional external services. Generated skills can preserve source errors, miss licensing boundaries, or overfit examples.
qualification: Run the same mixed documentation, repository, PDF, and test-fixture corpus through native and adapted intake. Measure source coverage, false skill detection, provenance completeness, duplication, and review effort.

mechanism: Persist stable source identities, append-only evidence, atomic claims and support status so long research can be resumed and each delivered factual claim can be traced.
productionProposal: Adapt the source/evidence/claim ledger shape into Oracle research dossiers while keeping report format and retrieval tooling provider-neutral.
existingOverlap: Oracle already requires local and external evidence, while Mnemosyne preserves continuity. This candidate offers a compact durable bridge between retrieval, synthesis, verification, and resume.
rejectOrAdapt: Reject fixed minimum source counts as a quality substitute, mandatory auto-opened HTML/PDF, generic credibility scores without domain evidence, and claims of outperforming other systems without locally reproduced evaluation.
dependenciesAndRisks: The repository includes Python validators and search-provider assumptions that were not executed. A ledger can still contain fabricated or correlated evidence unless source identity and claim support are independently checked.
qualification: Use a contradictory multi-source question and interrupt the run midstream. Verify resume, source identity, claim support, contradiction retention, citation locators, and removal of unsupported claims.
license: README states MIT, but no root LICENSE file was present in the pinned checkout; treat as license-unverified until clarified.
